Exquisite design & flexible functions

This extendable table combines sophisticated details with practical functionality. The tabletop, made of high-quality MDF+PB material and featuring elegant metal handles, impresses with its aesthetics and durability. The generous work surface offers ample space for working, dining, and other needs. The unique double-sided extension mechanism, with its additional leaf, allows for flexible adaptation to various situations. Whether for family gatherings or home office use, the table adapts effortlessly. A stable base ensures safety, while height-adjustable shelves and magnetic soft-close cabinet doors provide intelligent storage solutions.

Premium materials & intelligent storage

Crafted from environmentally friendly materials with meticulous precision, this table combines high-quality materials with functionality. The decorative tabletop and elegant metal handles lend a modern touch to any room. Height-adjustable shelves offer flexible storage, and magnetic soft-close doors close quietly and gently for a pleasant user experience. The sturdy base ensures long-lasting stability. Whether used as a dining table, desk, or display surface, this versatile piece of furniture is the perfect choice for sophisticated interior design concepts.
